summary.text: Roni Green is a Democratic member of the Pennsylvania House of Representatives for District 190, a seat she assumed on December 1, 2022, and is running for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Green graduated from Murrell Dobbins Vocational High School in 1977.
Her career experience includes working as a business agent and eastern Pennsylvania field organizer with SEIU Local 668.
